title: Tables & Data — Where It Stands
thesis: One enormous unified class, 2,517 methods with eleven sibling caps merged into a single stzTable, with engine-backed sort, aggregates, calculated columns, describe and pivot, plus a distinctive multi-table TableX pattern-query language. Measured against pandas, Polars and DuckDB it has three real holes: there is no join at all; group-by and filter run Ring-side even though engine bridges for both sit exported-but-unused; and the columnar engine is used per-operation, not as the live store.

lanes.note: AddCalculatedCol with an @(:ColName) formula lowered engine-first through StzEngineListEvalRows (compile-once), Ring eval() fallback; guarded at 50k rows
SortOn(col) via StzEngineTableSortOn to table.zig sortOnColumn: an index-permutation pdq sort that moves companion columns without copying row objects
From list-of-columns or hashlist; CSV, JSON, HTML round-trips; SQLite via stzDatabase; no Parquet/Arrow/Excel; FromJson is #TODO; iscsv guards fail (collision)
Per-column type_hint and per-cell tags in table.zig; Cell/Row/Col/Section access; legacy aliases (colsection, rowz, cellsincol) error after the 11-to-1 merge
Filter, FilterBy, FilterW/FilterWXT and TableX multi-table querying over stzListOfTables; all Ring-side, the engine ring_FilterRows exists but is never called
stzPivotTable + stzPivotTableShow engine-backed via StzEnginePivotCrossTab / ring_PivotGroupBy, plus Transpose variants; no melt / unpivot / wide-to-long
Describe() engine-backed through frame.zig (StzEngineFrameDescribeAll: 8 stats per column) plus whole-table regression (StzEngineFrameRegression)
Eleven caps merged into one stzTable namespace, old classes survive as ~1 KB shells; TableX pattern language over tables; 150 legacy tests left erroring
StzEngineTableSumCol / AvgCol / MinCol / MaxCol / ProductCol / CountNonNull: cache-friendly columnar scans, engine-backed
GroupBy/GroupByXT work as pure Ring row-wise hash-string keying; the engine groupByAggregate (ring_GroupBy) has O(n) hashed keys but stzTable never calls it
Per-cell null tags, AllItemsAreNull, CountNonNull and TableX null checks; no fillna / dropna / interpolate / forward-fill family
A real columnar engine (table.zig) and SQLite via stzDatabase, but the Ring table marshals row-wise @aContent per operation; no query planner, no lazy execution

standouts: A multi-table TableX pattern-query language with no direct peer
Engine-first calculated columns, compile-once over all rows, guarded at 50k rows
Eleven sibling caps merged into one stzTable namespace
gaps: Add joins: there is no join anywhere in the tables lane
Wire group-by and filter to the engine bridges already compiled and exported
Finish the 11-to-1 fidelity grind (150 of 251 legacy tests error)
Missing-data toolkit (fillna / dropna) and melt / unpivot
